title: Backroom A+B decision pass following user filtering
policy: A/B/H removed from active set, C normalised, D deferred, E/F merged and source-reviewed, G investigated and resolved (Bremen II distinct; Palazzina/Ca di Mazze separate entries 0.2km apart, not proven duplicates). Original archived evidence preserved in historical GitHub file, no live listings.json edits.

completed_duplicate_reviews.reason: Planet Randy explicitly describes Bürgerpark Bremen II as a SECOND spot a few hundred metres from main Bürgerpark, parallel to Parkallee between Otto-Gildemeister-Straße and Fitgerstraße. Its map link uses the locality plus-code 3RRH+8X Bremen. This is not an exact duplicate.

The Palazzina source itself lists 'Zona Industriale - Ca di Mazze' as another nearby listing 0.2 km away. It describes an industrial dirt pull-in past a roundabout. Two source entries are not yet demonstrated to be the exact same stopping place.
